TorBox account
A second account beside Real-Debrid. Once connected, the videos in your own TorBox account can be played in SCARY\'s player, and a torrent you choose can be added to it.

The connection is your TorBox API key: it gives full access to the account and does not run out. Disconnecting removes it from this TV. To cut it off everywhere, reset the API key in TorBox\'s settings.
TorBox sees the TV\'s IP address, your torrents and which of your files you play. The connection is stored encrypted on this TV only; nothing is sent to SCARY.
